two_arm_committed.source: committed two-arm read (_meta.cost_sensitivity, t_learner vs mail-everyone at 25% budget)

scalars.model_estimated_note: Multi-arm read is MODEL-ESTIMATED at the policy level: incremental conversions are summed predicted uplift over the targeted set, not observed counterfactuals. Only the per-arm Qini/A-B contrasts on the randomized arm-vs-control pairs are empirical causal reads.

profit_grid.note: profit(f, c) = inc(f) * revenue_per_conversion - f * N * c; inc(f) is summed predicted uplift (model-estimated), CIs are paired row bootstrap (one shared resample per replication), percentile 95%

random.note: model-estimated random baseline: straight line to the best-arm full-send total (Qini 0 by construction)
